_README: Campus Registrar's Office, extracted from the PUP Citizen's Charter 2025 (1st Edition), Student Affairs and Services Office, Admissions and Registrations Office Services, External Services (PDF "1_CC Admission and Registrar(2).pdf", received 10/21/2026, pages 3 to 44). effective_from 2025-01-01 is an ASSUMPTION (edition year start); replace if the Charter prints an effective date. Standards carry the three-part duration (duration_days, duration_hours, duration_minutes). Each service carries service_scope EXTERNAL. Staff names printed in the Person responsible column are NOT imported (PM decision 10/21/2026, D7 held): designations only. Documents that apply to one group only, conditional documents and the claim-time documents are not mandatory (see CCMS_SEEDING_INSTRUCTIONS_10062026.md section 5.5). Review before importing. TEMPORARY (PM decision 10/21/2026): PUP-REG-GRD-001 (Correction of Name) prints no total time in the Registrar Charter; its standard of 6 days 7 hours 1 minute is the total of the old campus-Charter copy (CAMP-OSAS-GRD-003, p. 699). Replace it when the Registrar confirms the official total.

services.service_name: Processing of Request for Correction of Name in Conformity with the Philippines Statistics Authority Certificate of Live Birth and/or Correction of Name in the School Records
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Pay the amount for correction of name at the Cashier's Office
  1. Accept payment and issue official receipt.
  [Responsible: Cashier's Office]
Step 2. Submit accomplished Application for Correction of Name and required documents to the assigned Records Analyst
  2. Request client to sign the logbook
  3. Accept application and required documents and start initial assessment and verification of completeness.
  3.1 If documents are complete:
  3.1.1 Indicate in the clients copy of the application form the tentative date of release of requested Certification.
  3.1.2 Return the proof of payment and clients copy of the application form.
  3.2 If not complete, advice the client to comply with the lacking requirements otherwise the application will not be processed.
  [Responsible: Registrar]
Step 3. Check email for any updates or advisory from Head of Admission and Registration
  3.1 Process request and issue advisory and updates whenever necessary
  3.2 Notify the client when document is ready for release.
  [Responsible: Student Records]
Step 4. Present clients copy of application form together with authorization letter and ID, if claimant is immediate family member or Special Power of Attorney (SPA), if claimant is other than immediate family member.
  4.1 verify the documents presented
  4.2 issue the requested certification/s
  [Responsible: Student Records]
Step 5. Acknowledge receipt of the requested certification/s
  5. Request client to sign the logbook and evaluate the service rendered.
  [Responsible: Student Records]

services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Pay the amount indicated in the payment voucher through the Cashier's Office
  1.1 Accept payment and issues official receipt.
Step 2. Present proof of payment and submit the application at the Head of Admission and Registration
  a. Request client to sign logbook
  b. Accept application and required documents and start initial assessment and verification of completeness.
  c. If documents are complete:
  i. Indicate in the client copy of the application form the tentative date of release of requested TOR.
  ii. Return the proof of payment and client copy of the application form.
  d. If not complete, advice the client to comply with the lacking requirements otherwise the application will not be processed.
  [Responsible: Registrar; Student Records]
Step 3. Check email or follow up for any update or advisory from Registrar's Office
  a. Process request and issues advisory and updates whenever necessary
  b. Notify the client when document is ready for release.
  [Responsible: Student Records]
Step 4. Present clients copy of application form together with authorization letter and ID, if claimant is immediate family member or Special Power of Attorney (SPA), if claimant is other than immediate family member.
  a. verify the documents presented
  b. issues the requested TOR
  [Responsible: Registrar; Student Records]
Step 5. Acknowledge receipt of the requested TOR.
  a. Request Client to sign logbook and evaluate the service rendered.
  [Responsible: Student Records]
